style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration of a software factory shown as a coordinated team of distinct specialist figures working around one large shared board or screen on which a clean modern application is taking shape. The specialists read as an architect with a blueprint, a builder, a tester, a security reviewer, and a data specialist, drawn as stylized agents rather than literal people, with lines of collaboration linking them to the shared board. A sense of an entire delivery team working in concert, made of software rather than a physical assembly line. Muted Alberta cream palette, navy and rust accents, archival print quality, no text. All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
